rationale: Bizi.si register profile of one association: mine once for legal reps/headcount; commercial aggregator with unclear reuse terms.
LinkedIn company/People pages are high-velocity for board and secretariat changes but login-gated and ToS-restricted for automated collection.
Single Delo article on a GZS presidency change: good dated evidence, but the monitorable unit is the outlet/tag feed, not this URL.
Statutory ZJN-3 national tender portal, no siblings, public: core early-intent signal for payments/IT programmes in state financial bodies.
e-JN holds the tender documentation with FTE/role profiles, but bidder registration is generally required to pull full packages.
TED with open API and CPV/award structure gives Slovenia-filtered above-threshold notices and winning-supplier signals.
OPSI machine-readable procurement datasets enable cheap longitudinal buyer/supplier tracking; explicitly open-licensed.
STATIST is an analytical app over the same OPSI procurement data already covered by c_304; baselining only.
UJP javne objave carries statutory javni natecaj notices for the state payments operator: direct headcount and org-structure evidence.
jnplacila.si publishes concluded contracts and monthly payment reports: standalone domain, strong outsourcing ramp-up/wind-down proxy.
Central gov.si vacancy register is one crawl point covering UJP, FURS and MF javni natecaji; supersedes per-body polling.
eUprava explainer page is a static pointer into the c_308 vacancy database; useful for crawl mapping, not a recurring signal.
FURS careers page publishes IT/informatika javni natecaji for the largest state financial body: leading indicator of tax/payment modernisation.
SDH governance pages publish management-board calls and supervisory nominations: earliest formal leadership-change signal at state-influenced banks.
Annual management-report PDF series on an sdh.si sibling; retrospective consolidation, and the URL did not verify.
Ministry of Finance publishes the SDH supervisory poziv and its own javni natecaji: upstream trigger of the state-financial governance chain.
SID banka combines procurement notices and vacancies for a state-owned bank on its own domain: dual hiring plus tender signal.
KAD razpisi page is standalone but thin and largely redirects to the national portal; confirm it carries independent postings.
DKOM decision database exposes staffing/technical criteria and bidder identities behind contested banking and payment IT tenders.
ERAR transaction transparency traces actual payment flows from UJP/FURS/SID to named payments and IT vendors; contracted-headcount proxy.
Court of Audit report archive gives deep organisational, staffing-shortfall and IT-project detail on state financial bodies.
